jobs.occupation: Healthcare Therapy Area Insights (all genders) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your Role:At the intersection of science, strategy, and commercial impact, this role places you at the heart of some of the most consequential decisions in healthcare drug development and commercialization. As an Associate Director within the Global Strategic Insights function, you will serve as a trusted thought partner to therapy area commercial teams — translating complex market dynamics into clear, actionable intelligence that shapes how healthcare assets are launched, grown, and managed across major global markets.This role will interact primarily with the Rare Tumor and Specialty Therapy Area teams, partnering closely with colleagues who are driving some of the most strategically significant assets in the portfolio.You will own the end-to-end delivery of insights across one or more GSI disciplines (primary market research, competitive intelligence, or strategic forecasting), ensuring every recommendation is grounded in rigorous analysis and directly informs critical business decisions.Working with cross-functional partners across commercial strategy, market access and pricing, other GSI functions, and regional insights teams, you will drive insights that elevate decision quality at critical stages of the asset lifecycle.Who You Are :- A degree in life sciences, business, economics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience — is required.- 5 or more years of experience in at least one global strategic insights discipline — primary market research, competitive intelligence, data analytics, or strategic forecasting — ideally within the pharmaceutical or biopharma industry.- You have designed and led insights and KPI workstreams for in-market or launch assets, with at least 2 years of direct experience across pre-launch, launch, and post-launch phases.- You hold deep expertise in one or more of the following: qualitative and quantitative primary market research (study design, discussion guide development, strategic recommendations); global competitive intelligence (trial monitoring, congress coverage, strategic simulation); or topline forecasting (model building, opportunity assessment, scenario analysis).- You have global experience across two or more major markets — such as the US, China, EU4 and UK, or Japan — and bring a nuanced understanding of how market dynamics differ across regions.- You work effectively across functions, with a solid understanding of how commercial strategy, market access and pricing, and regional insights teams each contribute to asset success.- You are comfortable navigating the full medicine lifecycle — from proof-of-concept through in-market management — and understand how insights activities evolve at each stage.- You communicate complex findings with clarity and confidence, translating analytical outputs into compelling narratives that resonate with senior stakeholders and drive informed decisions.- English fluent, additional languages are a plusWhat we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe (Steuerberater/in)
jobs.description: Who we areWorldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.The opportunityAt Worldline, our technology addresses persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies. If you are a highly-skilled Tax director, specialized in German and Swiss tax, then get ready to join our company.This role will report to the Group Head of Tax.Day-to-day responsibilitiesAs a Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe, which include main entities notably in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Poland, you will be in charge of all the tax aspects related to this perimeter that can evolve depending on the activity. You will be the key contact and stakeholder of local accounting, controlling, legal and finances teams, as well as the main interlocutor for local tax authorities. You will also work closely with the group tax team in order to ensure proper implementation of group tax policy and strategy.Your key responsibilities include:- Manage tax aspects of subsidiaries mainly in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Poland (including country-specific tax structuring, transfer pricing compliance, limitation of interest deductibility, and local tax consolidation group) and compliance aspects, as CIT, VAT, local taxes returns and ensure compliance with local regulations.- Support local finance teams for annual financial statements under IFRS and local accounting rules (German HGB, Austrian UGB, Swiss GAAP); ensure correct and optimal application of IFRS, translating IFRS and tax standards into practical processes used across administrations.- Take ownership of tax processes at Group level for the Tax Cluster area and ensure coordination between local teams, Group Finance, and external advisors (including transfer pricing documentation, foreign tax credits, local incentives, and subsidies)- Provide advice and support to group tax team, finance, legal and operational teams on  tax matters including CIT, VAT, and country-specific taxes and compliance requirements. Identify issues and drive effective solutions- Conduct tax monitoring across the Tax Cluster perimeter, build local tax manuals and guides that are user friendly and understandable to a larger audience; train local finance and tax teams when required- Ensure management of tax audits and litigations as well as relationships with tax authorities in each jurisdiction: prepare, coordinate and validate responses (with support from external advisors if necessary).- Anticipate and assess tax risks across the Tax cluster perimeter, considering local regulatory changes and multi-country implications and work closely with group tax team in this respect. Identify issues and drive effective solutions- Support the group and local finance teams on reporting (budget/actuals/forecast), on the determination of tax results, current and deferred tax charges and VAT recovery ratio across all  Tax Cluster entities, coordinate the tax reporting and tax package process with local stakeholders, automate and improve processes, and harmonize local submissions as appropriate.- Monitor tax legislation and case law developments and ensure proactive adaptation.This list is non-exhaustive and is intended to evolve with the position and the person who joins the team.Who are we looking forWe look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow.- Minimum 12 years of experience within international direct taxation at Big4, international law firm or at a multinational organization; pursued graduation from university (Tax Law or Tax Economics).- Professional proficiency of English and German is required- Expert in Excel and good knowledge of reporting tool (SAP)- You demonstrate expertise in international Group tax matters, leveraging your previous experience.- You are diligent, independent, proactive, with strong analytical and synthesis abilities, and excellent written communication skills. - You take initiative, bring forward strategic proposals, and have strong interpersonal capabilities.- Knowledge of the payments, eCommerce or FinTech industry is a plus.Perks & BenefitsAt Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:- Be part of a company guided by a strong purpose to do good and recognized as top 1% of the most sustainable companies in all sectors worldwide- Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career- An exciting salary- At Worldline our top priority is to engage, encourage and develop you to help you improve your potential. In fact, we have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our dedication to developing your career- And many more...#LI-AB1Shape the evolutionWe are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.comWe are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: International Accounting/Financial Reporting Standards (IAS/IFRS), Rechnungslegung nach HGBExpertenkenntnisse: Tabellenkalkulation Excel (MS Office)

We are a family-owned business producing food of the highest quality in one of the most modern food manufacturing facilities in Europe. Our customers span the entire food industry.   "Taste the power of food" - and lead the way in shaping what food looks like tomorrow! To strengthen our dedicated team at our Georgsmarienhütte site, we are looking for a:    Senior Project Manager Food Industry (m/f/d) Full-time / permanent   The MMM begins with you: Join a team that brings together tradition and innovation - and let your passion for food lead the way. Your tasks include: Developing and implementing product and innovation projects from initial idea to successful market launch Identifying and evaluating market, food and consumer trends and deriving new product and concept ideas Further developing and managing a structured innovation process, including evaluation, piloting and implementation Developing economically viable innovation concepts, taking into account customer benefit, operational feasibility and margin targets Coordinating pilot projects and cross-site roll-outs, with continuous optimisation based on data and feedback Working initiatives Fostering a culture of innovation through workshops, idea exchange and cross-functional collaboration What you bring: A degree in Food Technology, Nutrition Science or a comparable processes Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills The ability to translate market and consumer trends into concrete, actionable concepts Commercial understanding of margins, jobs.employer_name: KiTA An der Bucerius Law School e.V
jobs.description: Create your own happiness!Are you a passionate early childhood educator (m/f/d)? Do you put your heart and soul into your work, but haven’t been satisfied with your working conditions so far?Come check us out—maybe you’ll like what you find here?What you can look forward to…The basics: pay, vacation time, and working hours.We are actually offering a fixed-term full-time position, but a reduction in hours is possible. The full-time workweek is 38 hours. Initially, the contract would be fixed-term due to parental leave, but an extension is possible.Pay is based on the TVöD SuE collective bargaining agreement and depends on your professional experience and qualifications. A 13th month’s salary (at 100%, instead of 85%) is paid after one year of service. We have between 32 and 34 days of vacation per year. Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve are paid holidays. The cost of an HVV/Deutschlandticket is fully covered, and if interested, you can participate in a fitness program.The Position: Responsibilities and Working Conditions.We are looking for at least one new early childhood educator with a perfect command of the English language.Your responsibilities include the attentive care, nurturing, and support of the infants entrusted to us in accordance with our educational philosophy, working closely with the children, parents, and the entire team. Your would spend your daily life spekaing English.You would be a permanent member of the nursery team. Some experience in this field and a preference for this age group would be advantageous.Our working conditions are truly worth highlighting: In the elementary section, four colleagues together care for 35 children; in the nursery section, four additional colleagues care for 16 children. In addition, we employ a housekeeping staff member with educational qualifications and, in the future, a substitute.We hold weekly team meetings to discuss weekly schedules, activities, and specific situations, as well as to plan parent-teacher conferences and developmental meetings. Our sponsoring organization places great emphasis on providing good working conditions.The Team: One for all, all for one!Some of us have been working together successfully and happily for over ten years. It goes without saying that we support one another and treat each other with care. Our sense of humor and our willingness to stand up for one another carry us through the sometimes hectic daily routine of the daycare center.On concept days, we discuss educational topics, engage in professional development, and reflect on our work. Regular weekly team meetings, preparation time, and supervision are just as much a part of our routine as extended get-togethers during company outings and Christmas parties.Has this piqued your curiosity? Then be sure to read on…Important: Empathy, joy, and qualifications.To ensure we comply with legal requirements, it is very important that our new team member holds a completed, state-recognized qualification as an early childhood educator (m/f/d), a degree in early childhood education or early childhood development, or a degree as a social pedagogue (m/f/d). It would be helpful if you have a good understanding of the English language, as we are a bilingual facility.We are looking for an empathetic person with a Reggio Emilia approach (including a child-centered perspective) and someone who genuinely enjoys working with children, because we want you to look forward to coming to work.Feel free to get to know us!The Daycare Center: Location. Concept. Focus Areas.The daycare center is located in the heart of Planten un Blomen and is surrounded by plenty of greenery. It is easily accessible by public transportation from all parts of Hamburg (Gänsemarkt, Dammtor, Stephansplatz).There are two groups, a nursery group and an elementary group, in which 46 children are currently cared for by eight early childhood educators. Our facilities allow us to organize various projects and activities in workshops and specialized rooms.The foundation of our concept is the Reggio approach. Above all, it reflects our attitude toward others and how we wish to approach life’s changes. Our daycare is a place for self-directed, holistic learning, and we foster a respectful approach not only toward the children entrusted to us, but toward all people.We integrate key areas such as yoga, woodworking, art studio work, language development, music, relaxation and movement, and preschool preparation into our daily routine. Do you have a particular focus? A passion? Let’s find out together if we can integrate this into our daily routine as well…Start up initiative: Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.Our small operator, “Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.”, was founded in 2008 and is a member of the Paritätischer Wohlfahrtsverband Hamburg. jobs.occupation: Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX project (Fachinformatiker/in - Anwendungsentwicklung)
jobs.description: Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX projectSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Center (SDMC) at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as soon as possible:Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX project(Full-Time / Part-Time)Location: FrankfurtEmployment scope: Full-Time / Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, initially limited to 2 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E11- E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.The position is within the Geobiodiversity Information and Data Management team of the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Centre and contributes to a project funded by the European Union, TETTRIX – TETTRIs neXt level for the taxonomy of tomorrow. The team works at the interface of biodiversity informatics, ecological modelling, and data management, focusing on integrating, analysing, and making biodiversity data accessible for research and conservation. The TETTRIX project aims to strengthen taxonomic capacity for biodiversity research by developing, validating, and scaling innovative tools, workflows, services, and training pathways, while addressing critical knowledge and capacity gaps across Europe. Within the TETTRIX project, the position will develop a web-based, open-access biodiversity mapping and Species Distribution Modelling (SDM) platform that enables reproducible data and modelling workflows and transforms biodiversity data into actionable knowledge for biodiversity monitoring and conservation. The role combines full-stack software development with biodiversity data integration and close collaboration with researchers and technical partners.Your tasks- Develop the platform's web application end-to-end: SPA frontend (interactive map, species/variable selection, model-run monitoring) and REST API backend.- Integrate the application with the PostgreSQL/PostGIS metadata layer and the AWS-side batch and data-lake services.- Co-design and implement the data infrastructure of the Open Modular SDM Platform, including a columnar lakehouse (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask on AWS Batch) covering the full GBIF and OBIS datasets.- Develop and operate the hybrid infrastructure, integrating AWS-based services with the institute's internal serving layer (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, map tiles and APIs), and coordinate the associated technical tasks.- Implement map-tile serving, caching and optimise frontend performance.- Set up and maintain CI/CD, automated tests and containerised deployment (Docker) in cooperation with central IT.- Participate in project and team meetings and coordinate closely with the scientific team on a day-to-day basis.Your profile- Degree in Computer Science or comparable practical experience.- Solid skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern framework (React, Vue or similar).- Backend experience in Python (e.g. FastAPI/Flask) or Node.js; sound REST API design.- Experience with SQL/PostgreSQL; PostGIS and web-mapping libraries (MapLibre GL, Leaflet, OpenLayers) are a strong plus.- Experience with cloud-based data infrastructure, particularly AWS services (S3, Batch).- Knowledge of columnar data storage and lakehouse technologies (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask).- Experience with data pipelines, batch processing and the integration of large-scale datasets.- Knowledge of hybrid infrastructure architectures and the integration of cloud-based and on-premises services.- Experience with Docker, Git and CI/CD.- Very good command of English.- Willingness to work on site in Frankfurt (up to 40% remote work is possible).Desirable skills- Familiarity with open-access biodiversity databases such as the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) and the Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS), Darwin Core standards, and biodiversity data life cycles- Familiarity with species distribution modelling and associated statistical/machine-learning approaches (e.g. GLM/GAM, MaxEnt, Random Forest)- A track record in scientific publications, reproducible scientific computing, or open-source projectsWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter of motivation, CV, relevantcertificates and references, if available) electronically as a single PDF by 15. November2026.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Dr. Hanieh Saeediat hanieh.saeedi@senckenberg.de

Experience in aircraft construction, aerospace, IT or information systems provides a strong basis for the responsibilities of the Quality Conformance Manager A320 (d/m/w).- Degree or advanced technical qualification in aircraft construction, computer science, aerospace, industrial engineering or a comparable technical discipline.- More than one year of experience in IT, information systems, project management, quality management and supply-chain-related activities is preferred.- Knowledge of quality-management principles, Total Quality Management and structured problem-solving methods.- Experience with data analysis, quality findings, root-cause evaluation and the derivation of improvement measures.- Sound understanding of supply-chain processes, supplier interfaces and collaboration between procurement, production, logistics and final assembly.- Strong organisational skills, a structured working approach and the ability to maintain an overview of several tasks and activities at the same time.- Proactive, autonomous and responsible working style combined with a practical, hands-on approach and resilience in a changing environment.- Confident communication, cooperation skills and the ability to negotiate and resolve conflicts in multifunctional and international teams.- Fluent German and English communication skills at a level suitable for professional negotiations and technical coordination.- Working knowledge of Google Workspace and an affinity for digital tools, KPI reporting and information systems.- Willingness to travel worldwide up to approximately once per quarter.- Working hours: full-time, 35 hours per week.Benefits:- An unlimited employment contract- 35-hour workweek- 30 days of annual leave- An annual salary of around 72.000 €- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

jobs.occupation: Quality Conformance Manager (d/m/w) AIRBUS (Qualitätsmanager/in)
jobs.description: As a Quality Conformance Manager (d/m/w) in Hamburg, the role focuses on quality assurance, structured problem solving and process excellence within a global operations and training environment. The position coordinates quality notifications and corrective actions across the spare parts and kits portfolio while serving as an important interface between international teams, technical experts and customer-facing functions.- Monitor, validate and analyse incoming Notification of Escape (NOE) and Quality Survey Report (QSR) requests, assessing their operational impact on spare parts and kits.- Define, coordinate and implement rapid containment measures to mitigate quality defects and prevent non-conforming items from affecting customer operations.- Manage Discrepancy Reports related to NOE, QSR and CAPRI processes, ensuring that quality tasks are validated, assigned, tracked and closed efficiently.- Coordinate Airworthiness Directive analysis and resolution, including the structured assessment of safety-related items and the implementation of appropriate follow-up actions.- Represent QSR processes during internal and external quality audits and demonstrate compliance with applicable aerospace quality standards.- Work with international colleagues and global expert networks to align containment activities, exchange specialist knowledge and resolve complex quality topics.- Contribute QSR expertise to cross-functional transformation initiatives, process management activities and continuous process improvement projects.- Support customer satisfaction by applying structured problem-solving methods and maintaining a consistent focus on quality, reliability and timely resolution.VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:- Completed technical education or a relevant qualification in aircraft construction, engineering, or aerospace; comparable expertise in an aerospace-related discipline is suitable.- Several years of professional experience in aircraft manufacturing, aerospace mechanics, quality management, quality assurance, maintenance, or upkeep/maintenance services.- Practical knowledge of process improvement, process management, and Total Quality Management, including structured problem-solving methods.- Experience in analyzing quality deviations, coordinating containment activities, and driving corrective actions through to completion.- Ability to work independently, organize priorities effectively, and maintain a high level of attention to detail when handling complex quality topics.- Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in multifunctional teams and with international expert networks.- Confident German and English language skills for professional communication in a global working environment.- Working conditions include full-time employment with 35 hours per week.Benefits:- An unlimited employment contract- 35-hour workweek- 30 days of annual leave- An annual salary of around 72.000 €- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

jobs.occupation: Supplier Quality Manager (d/f/m) AIRBUS (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description: As a Supplier Quality Manager (d/f/m) in Hamburg, you will work across the cabin perimeter and help safeguard reliable supplier performance throughout the aerospace supply chain. The role combines Supply Chain, Logistics, supplier quality, risk management and continuous improvement activities in an international operating environment.Your tasks:- Monitor supplier delivery, quality and cost performance using relevant key performance indicators, and initiate immediate containment actions where required to protect industrial operations.- Coordinate and follow up on recovery plans with suppliers when delivery reliability or product quality declines.- Support the industrial qualification of products and suppliers in line with supplier requirements and applicable airworthiness, safety and industrial standards.- Conduct industrial supplier audits and assessments, documenting findings and coordinating appropriate improvement measures.- Develop the capacity and capabilities of cabin suppliers through continuous-improvement approaches, including APQP, Lean methods and joint supplier-development activities.- Monitor new product introductions and transfers of work across the Lieferkette to maintain end-to-end consistency and on-time, on-quality performance.- Identify and manage industrial risks in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders, applying structured Risikomanagement and Total Quality Management principles.- Manage interfaces with program teams, final assembly operations and other internal stakeholders, while communicating effectively with contacts at different levels of supplier organizations.VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:- Completed studies or comparable qualifications in aerospace, engineering, industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related technical or commercial discipline.- Practical experience in Lieferantenmanagement, Supply Chain Quality, Qualitätsmanagement or Qualitätssicherung; experience in the Luft- und Raumfahrt environment is advantageous.- Sound understanding of quality-management methods and tools such as APQP, Control Plans, PFMEA, 8D/9S, VSM or comparable problem-solving approaches.- Knowledge of Supply Chain processes, supplier performance management, industrial qualification, audits and continuous-improvement activities.- Experience with Risikomanagement and TQM, meaning Total Quality Management, including the structured analysis of causes, risks and improvement measures.- Confident use of Windows-based working environments and SAP/R3; familiarity with Google Workspace is also expected.- Strong analytical skills and the ability to quickly understand functional processes, dependencies and operational interrelationships.- Independent, structured and results-oriented approach, combined with reliable deadline and workflow coordination.- Very good German and business-fluent English skills; French is an advantage.- Willingness to travel worldwide up to approximately once per month is required.- Full-time employment with 35 hours per week.Benefits:- An unlimited employment contract- 35-hour workweek- 30 days of annual leave- An annual salary of around 75.000 €- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment
